name: five-player
note: FIVE PLAYERS, which is the size of the table at Oliver's -- edgar-vampires 002 and 004, goblin-storm 002 and ur-dragon 003 are all 'five-player pod: Sean, Oliver, Tom, Alex, Ryan'. Two seats are observed (Krenko, Purphoros) and two are EDHREC archetype coverage standing in for the decks the log does not name. Pod SIZE is the point of this file: a bigger table means more removal aimed at you and a longer clock, and nothing measured that before pods existed.
